arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} Casting Zealot Skills grants Do or Die on hit, increasing your Critical Strike damage by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2" |1x%|]{/c} and Cast Speed by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3" |1%+|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} times.
